title: Great way to see Barcelona with kids
text: We had a wonderful tour today with Thomas! We are a family with three young kids (ages 7,4 and almost 2) and they had the perfect setup. Our oldest on her own bike, the middle on a tag a long and the youngest in a child seat. We saw SO MUCH more of Barcelona than we ever would have been able to without the tour and our kids loved biking. Thomas was patient when our kids wanted snack and water breaks, offered to take photos for us and was great ant navigating traffic and bike lanes for us. I definitely recommend!
author: Jenessa_B

title: Great time!
text: Our guide Julio was awesome! Great family experience. Our kids are 11 and 12 and it was totally fine for them. Julio knows a lot about the history of the city and made the ride entertaining and fun.
author: Sheila_K

title: Yes! Our guide Laureline was great. This was a fantastic experience. Thank you Laureline!
text:
Our bike guide Laureline was fantastic. She was professional, kind and informative. The bike tour experience itself was great. 
Our guide Laureline did a wonderful job of not only giving us information, but it was not boring. We had our 10 year child with us. We feel safe, not rushed, learned a lot but also it was relaxed and fun. The exertion was fine. I suppose if you are "out of shape" and find it difficult to ride a bike, well, then perhaps look for something else. But this was not difficult. It was quite lovely.

author: Chelsey_K

title: Great tour for family with kids
text: Amazing family tour! Bikes are in great condition. Great trailer or small bike options for kids. Laureline is very informative and made it fun for the kids. Laureline is a joy and has great energy. Will recommend!!
author: 325lisetteh

title: Great for our family!
text: We have kids ages 8 and 10, and this tour was perfect for our family of four.  Lauraline was our guide, and she was preemptive to reach out to us prior to the tour to find the best fit of bikes for our kids.  She reserved a tag-along trailer just in case our 8 year old couldn't manage the hand brakes, but said we could change our mind if we needed to.  On the day of, she offered to meet up with us earlier to get started earlier.  The whole tour, she was so personable and stayed very engaged with our family. author: Nancy_H

title: Fun, flexible while learning about the main history of Barcelona.
text:
We were very lucky to have had Laurien as our English guide as she is a very helpful, kind, flexible and understanding guide, for both the adults and kids. 
She speaks many languages and explained the history of monuments and locations clearly for the kids and adults, without too much information. 
We got to cover the whole tour even though extra time was taken up with delays at certain stops but Laurien never made the group feel under pressure. Highly recommend a tour with Laurien for a mixed tour of adults
 and kids of all ages.
Thanks a lot Laurien and for the tips!
Family van Tuijl x
author: D1273GEmarcov

title: Best way to tour Barcelona for every age!
text: Laureline was an amazing guide for our group of eight ranging in age from 8 yo to 82 yo! She was easygoing, enthusiastic and was always aware of everyone’s needs (including my mom who rode on the tandem bike). She gave some great history and information without overload and really knew her audience. She brought us on easily navigable routes and was flexible in terms of pace and timing. She extended our tour by an extra hour because we got a slow start. It was better than we expected and she showed us all the top spots including the beach. author: Dawn_L

title: Excellent Bike Tour for Families
text: Bike Barcelona with Laureline was our favorite day in Barcelona.  We have three children of very different ages (7, 14, and 18) and many times on a holiday it can be difficult to find an activity that everyone can enjoy but this one made our whole family very happy.  All smiles, and lots of fun!  Our 7 year old could keep up with us on her own bike perfectly and the tour was on a very family friendly route. author: 704natalieq

title: I 100% recommend
text: For our Team Building, we chose the guided walking tour of the old town, which was a great experience! Laureline is an excellent guide, and taught us a lot about this part of the city. It was very interesting and beautiful! We recommend it 100%!
author: audreylE8363WA

title: Fun tour!
text: Laureline was a great guide and we had so much fun on this bike tour. Recommend seeing the city by bike rather than on foot because you can cover so much more ground! We were able to bike all around the city and inside the parks too. It was fabulous!
author: Pauline_T
